A weapon written the way a vault's reference notes are: the values in the
frontmatter, the block naming the system and the card type. The kind in
the header follows from the stats — no protection, no parry modifier,
so a weapon; two injury diamonds for the two grips; the picture between
the rules. Invented for this deck.

```card-forge
card:
  system: tor2e
  card-type: gear
```
